note: Total charged-current cross section per nucleon divided by energy (sigma/E) for numu and numubar on isoscalar nuclei (marble target), CHARM wide-band beam, flux-averaged over ~10-160 GeV. The two canonical CHARM slopes sigma_numu/E = 0.686 and sigma_numubar/E = 0.335 x10^-38 cm^2/GeV/nucleon. No arXiv (1988 paper); transcribed from the published values. No covariance.
